Health.summary: Invasive mould infections are being highlighted as an underreported and potentially deadly threat, particularly for immunocompromised individuals. key_points: Invasive mould infections are an underreported deadly threat.
They are particularly dangerous for immunocompromised individuals.
Experts call for increased awareness and research.
